source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The unifinder Future filter starts at today as a date and ends 100 years later. Its comment explains that the finite range avoids recurring-event performance problems. All likewise uses a finite 100-year range on each side. The filter API clones dates, makes them immutable and defines its end as exclusive. Keep the user-facing label separate from the query bound and document such limits when changing filters. This source does not prove infinite future coverage or measure the performance improvement.
title: Bound the calendar Future view and preserve date-range semantics
